title: What happens if you find your original ball on the course?
question: You hit a provisional ball, but then find your original ball on the course (not out of bounds) within 3 minutes. What should you do next?

choices.text: Pick up the provisional ball and play the original ball
Play whichever ball is in a better position
Play both balls and choose the best result

explanation: You must stop playing the provisional ball and continue with your original ball. Any strokes played with the provisional ball do not count.
imagePrompt: Teenage girl golfer on the sunny fairway, using an iron to pick up her provisional ball after finding her original ball. Only one ball left visible on the fairway.
imageAlt: Teenage girl golfer on the fairway picking up a second ball, original ball in play.
